notes.title: Resonant Blade: Patch 1.0.9
notes.notes:
Just a couple of bug fixes for this one.

[b]Locria Sewers Red Orb[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where taking the red orb up the elevator would cause it to spawn in an unreachable area.
[*] You can no longer take the orb up the elevator.
[*] If this already happened in your save, the red orb will now respawn in its original location.
[/list]

[b]Title Screen[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where clicking “Load File” repeatedly could continue to trigger loads after one had already started.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.8 – August 6, 2025
notes.notes:
Frame rate is now capped at 60 FPS to reduce unnecessary hardware load.

Closed the hoverboard shop. It was never fully implemented or tested, and likely contains bugs.
(Still accessible via the Konami code, but use at your own risk.)

notes.title: Patch 1.0.7
notes.notes:
[b]Patch 1.0.7[/b]
Hey, everyone. Just a few quick fixes for today.

[list]
[*] Fixed bug where players could clip through walls in the Undersea Research Lab Cargo Bay
[*] Fixed bug in Cargo Bay box sliding puzzle where adjacent boxes could overlap and break the puzzle
[*] Removed unintended menu click SFX during elevator scene transitions
[*] Background music now fades out properly in Locria Reactor Rooms
[/list]

Thanks again for the reports and feedback!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.6 - New Tunes & Final Boss Fixes
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Patch 1.0.6 is here with fresh music for Ionia City and several fixes for the final boss fight and beyond. Here’s what’s new:

🎵 Audio

Added new layered music for Ionia City (indoor/outdoor transitions)

⚔️ Final Boss Fight

Menus can no longer lock up during the final encounter

Shield HP bar now properly resets to 0 after stunning in Phase II

Fixed bug where the boss could summon enemies multiple times without waiting for the first wave to be defeated

Fixed rare issue where the boss would get stuck entering the Satellite Beam phase when all Resonant Orbs were destroyed

🧪 Other Fixes

Undersea Research Lab [Main Lab]: Fixed a collision issue in the top-left corner where players could clip through

Fixed bug where explosive crates weren’t dealing damage to the player

Cymatic Heal visual effects now reset properly after using another Triad ability

Fixed controller issue: You can now attack, parry, and dash while channeling Cymatic Heal

Company splash screen at the start is now skippable


Thanks again for all your support and bug reports. Keep the feedback coming!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5 – Ghost III Tweaks & Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
🔧 Ghost III Adjustments

[list]
[*] Reduced Wave Blade phase duration
[*] Projectiles now fire in triplet bursts. Each burst is a single tone. In the final phase, volleys form full Triads (Wave Blade, Sonic Slam, Phase Shifter, or Harmony Shield)
[*] Slight HP reduction
[*] Increased stunned duration
[/list]

🐛 Bug Fixes

[list]
[*] Fixed bug where dying during Ghost III would respawn you with the Resonant Blade already equipped, causing a 2x scale visual glitch when picking it up
[*] Fixed an issue with the Neon Cyclone mod where dash, parry, and heal actions could become temporarily locked during combat
[/list]

Thanks for playing and reporting bugs! More updates on the way 🔊⚔️

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.3 – Ionia Sewer Gate Access Fixed
notes.notes:
Fixed issue where enemy in Ionia Sewers didn’t always drop the keycard.

Gates in the area will now automatically open once all enemies have been destroyed, ensuring smoother progression.

Thanks for the report!

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.2 – Minigame Tweaks, Bug Fixes, and Navigation Polish
notes.notes:
Another quick patch to keep things running smoothly:

✅ Fixed navigation lockup in the Options menu (from 1.0.1)

🕹️ Made the SmashSynths minigame slightly easier to complete

🔧 Nerfed HoverTurret HP in the Underwater Tunnel

🏆 Fixed TunnelRunner Achievement not triggering right after the speeder minigame

🧭 Added more hints to help players find the docks in Locria City

🛑 Fixed a bug where the Underwater Tunnel speeder was incorrectly enabled when crossing to the Locria side

Thanks again for all the bug reports and feedback. Keep 'em coming! More improvements and updates are in the works.

notes.title: Quick hotfix for Options Navigation getting stuck
notes.notes:
Quick update:
I fixed an issue where the Options menu could get stuck or become unresponsive when navigating with a controller or keyboard. Everything should now work smoothly.

Thanks for reporting this! More polish and improvements on the way!

notes.title: Demo Update 0.2.0 – No Outlines. No Mercy.
notes.notes:
[h1][b]🔧 Demo Patch 0.2.0 is Live![/b][/h1][h3]We’ve got a fresh round of updates, improvements, and new features for the [i]Resonant Blade[/i] demo. Here's what's new in 0.2.0:[/h3][p][/p][p]🧭 [b]Inventory & Options Menu Now Accessible Immediately[/b] You can now access your inventory and settings right from the start of the demo.[/p][p]🎧 [b]Hard Mode Added[/b]
Enable/Disable in Options menu. Enemy outlines are gone. Projectiles are all white. You'll have to [i]listen[/i] closely for each enemy’s Resonant Tone to counter effectively. Trust your ears.[/p][p]🩸 [b]More Blood. More Particles. More Oomph.[/b]
Combat feels snappier with new blood FX and extra impact particles on hits.[/p][p]🤖 [b]Otto’s Combat Support Activated[/b]
Your trusty droid Otto can now:
• [b]Fire a Sonic Chirp[/b] to damage enemies
• [b]Deploy Bio-Repair[/b] to heal you in battle
These trigger automatically when using the scanner.[/p][p]💬 [b]New Dialogue: Cid & Dr. Somers[/b]
They’ll fill you in on Otto’s new abilities and what to expect.[/p][p]🐛 [b]Bug Fix[/b]
Scanner no longer cancels if you get knocked back.[/p][p]🚀 [b]Jetpack Swordfighter Upgrade[/b]
This enemy now uses smarter pathfinding at the intro level. Try running and you might just get flanked from above.[/p][hr][/hr][p]Let us know what you think, and keep that feedback coming!
💥 Wishlist [i]Resonant Blade[/i] and get ready for launch coming soon![/p][p][/p][p][i]normal mode difficulty[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42743809/281a599d01e290f2049078975c01f7827ba2b061.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][i]hard mode difficulty[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42743809/96c237785256ac33aa6efe84faa86d2d7a5fdec5.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][i]Otto Sonic Chirp[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42743809/7732f22990db38e7ab8d8ed00f13e28ef5fb2373.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][i]Otto Bio-Repair[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42743809/9139c757598c2ef463827538175b8a77e4c006f8.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p]
